summary.en-US: A new tab board for Firefox tabs, groups, pins, and widgets. Save groups as bookmarks, sync across devices, and switch to an existing tab instead of opening a duplicate.

description.en-US:
**Your tabs on one board**
Foxy replaces the new tab and home pages with a board of open tabs, groups, pins, and widgets. Drag tabs between groups, reopen saved groups, and choose a clock, weather, or pinned-tab widget. Desktop Firefox 140 or newer is required.

**Groups and Sync**
Groups and pins are saved in Other Bookmarks/Foxy. Firefox Sync carries them and your board layout between devices. Ungrouped, unpinned tabs and tab history are not saved. Private windows are not shown or synced.

**Duplicate tabs**
Opening a foreground link can switch to an existing tab instead of leaving a duplicate. Foxy respects containers and browsing mode. You can turn this off in settings.

**Weather and privacy**
Weather is optional. Requests go to Open-Meteo and BigDataCloud only after you select Allow weather. Coordinates are rounded to two decimals before requests. Search for a city to use weather without geolocation permission. Foxy collects no data and needs no account.

**Optional tools on GitHub**
The [Firefox theme](https://github.com/guru-irl/foxy#theme) and [local agent helper](https://github.com/guru-irl/foxy#agents) are separate, optional installs. The open-source helper lets an agent manage tabs and powers the MEMORY widget. Without it, the agent CLI and memory measurements are unavailable. The board works without either tool.

**Permissions**
- Tabs and tab groups let Foxy display, open, move, pin, and close tabs and groups.
- Bookmarks save groups and pins for Firefox Sync.
- Storage saves settings, layouts, and tab mappings.
- Scripting keeps a renamed pin's page title. Optional site access is requested only when you rename a pin on that site.
- Native messaging connects the optional local helper for the agent CLI and MEMORY.
- Optional geolocation uses your location for weather. Optional location data consent allows weather requests.
